operational.targets: One point on solid ground or a suitable immobile surface that you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier with concentration; no glow survives the ward.
operational.resolution: No roll. At each actual outside-to-inside entry, the Director determines whether that creature has an actual current hostile relationship toward you in the encounter/campaign state. A qualifying entry starts or refreshes the visible signal for 6 elapsed seconds from that entry, capped by the ward’s own endpoint.
operational.effect: Place one faintly visible magical sigil watching a fixed area 10 feet in radius and 10 feet high above its surface. Qualifying hostility may be secret if it is an actual current fictional fact; do not infer it from species, alignment, faction, reputation, appearance or suspicion. Undefined hostility does not become hostile merely to trigger the spell. Entry includes voluntary movement, forced movement and teleportation that actually occupies the area. Creation around an already-present creature is not entry; it must leave and reenter. Ordinary intervening cover within the area does not prevent physical entry from triggering, but a protection blocking the creature’s new Divination information can prevent its trigger. During a signal the mark is self-luminous and visible under ordinary line-of-sight rules; it does not illuminate surrounding squares. Its only direct report is that at least one qualifying entry occurred recently. Repeated entries refresh the same signal, without separate counted pulses or a stored log.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration, uses or information.
operational.limitations: One Warning Ward per caster. The area stays fixed; moving or destroying its supporting surface ends the ward rather than making a portable detector. Ending concentration or suppressing the ward prevents new signals and removes its visible glow; suppression does not pause the ward’s duration or replay missed entries when it ends. A formerly signaled entry is not a new entry just because suppression ends. No damage, restraint, sound alarm, creature outline, square, count, identity, type, statistics or detailed intention is reported. Actual observers can make ordinary inferences from the glow and its timing. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement, although an applicable concentration transition has already happened. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs commit before the counter window without refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Explicit remote-destination/concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect only as printed. Specific information protections apply to their actual subject and generating-source scope; hidden but unprotected facts are valid information, and missing facts are never invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30feet/concentration1minute, a trap glowing on enemy entry and no damage; Core M/F follows shared F interpretation. NEW: fixed 10-foot-radius/height region, actual-hostility predicate, no trigger on creation, and signal lasting exactly 6 elapsed seconds rather than an ambiguous turn marker. Exact-card completion specifies self-luminous-only signal, ordinary-cover entry behavior, suppression and moved-surface endings.
